eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Six
subtitle: Lesson 61 · Subqueries, CTEs, and Views

code:
-- Wide: SalesID | Q1Sales | Q2Sales | Q3Sales | Q4Sales

SELECT SalesID, Quarter, SalesAmount
FROM QuarterlySales
UNPIVOT (
  SalesAmount FOR Quarter
  IN (Q1Sales, Q2Sales, Q3Sales, Q4Sales)
) AS UnpivotedData;
caption: Four columns become TWO — Quarter and SalesAmount — one row per original column.
